name: mirage
text: The engine restarted on a fresh runner, but it reports: 'no Novig key was sent to GitHub'. So the send did not reach GitHub's secrets (the old mismatched pair is gone, the new one isn't there). Please open Settings > Cloud scan and tap 'Send a Novig read-only key' once more, and tell me exactly what line it shows afterwards (sent, or an error such as a permission message). If it shows an error, send me those words. The GitHub token saved in the app needs 'Secrets: read and write' for the send to work.
